value: Heavy drinkers showed significantly greater activation than light drinkers in the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and anterior/mid cingulate during NoGo trials.

The increased activity in heavy drinkers was interpreted as reflecting increased working-memory demand and cognitive-control efforts to withhold a response because of poorer inhibitory control and enhanced salience of alcohol cues.
